decision_rule: All seven gates pass: the candidate is selected and integrated as possession-v2.17 (new entry point derived from run216.py; byte copies of features2.py and infer.py of commit 74bedbf; the eight d6 files with the SHA-256 below; new manifest; v2.16 becomes the next step of the technical ladder). It replaces v2.16 in the delivery only if, by 16 Nov 2026 23:59 Istanbul (the last moment already named in the v2.15 and v2.16 plans, not moved), the ported inference runs under Python 3.10 / numpy 1.26.4, the output on synthetic provided-like bundles is byte-identical across Python 3.10 / numpy 1.26.4 and Python 3.13 / numpy 2.5.3, the full test suite passes, a full-size chain rehearsal ends OK, and the documents describe the new members, their training as stated by their author, and this fourth attempt with the statement it departs from; and only if the delivery chain then runs OK on the team's computer. Otherwise v2.16 stays. Any gate fails: v2.16 stays the release and the candidate is recorded as tried and not used. Whatever the outcome, no further candidate with the second model is registered before the deadline. The gates are applied once, to all rows; nothing is re-run with other seeds, members, weights or pools.
reported_alongside: every row; means per source in every condition; both arms against v2.11; the network alone of both arms; frames changed; the path and the state of the accuracy gate per copy
not_part_of_this_validation: The Smart Tagging kick-off rule (unchanged, not measurable externally).
The provided match: not read, not run and not scored.
Pooling on the v2.3 path (explored by the author, not part of the candidate).
The training of the members (not observed and not repeated here).
limits: Fourth registered attempt with the second model, and the first made after a written statement that there would be none. Each validation used new copies, but repeated attempts with the same gates on the same four matches make a pass easier; a pass here is weaker evidence than a pass at the first attempt would have been. A stopping statement that is set aside once promising numbers appear protects less than one that is kept.

The candidate was built, tuned and first checked by its author on his own computer; this process only validates the committed files. That the training used external matches only and that the provided match was not opened is the author's statement.

The validation matches were used for every earlier selection of v2.x, for the author's development grid (the 40 copies of the v2.14 and v2.15 validations: member sets and the weight 0.4 were chosen there) and for his check. Only the copies are new. The d4 members have not seen the two DFL validation matches; the d6 members were trained on all six DFL matches and are scored on the Metrica games only. This is a validation, not a fresh test.
There is no untouched test for any pooled system: J03WMX was used in the development of the network recipe by its author, Metrica game 3 in the development of v2.14 and v2.15.
Corruption, slot packing and broadcast camera are simulated by the team; the provided tracking may differ. The members were shown the two simulators and nothing else.
DFL labels are the provider's per-frame flags; Metrica labels are the team's event-derived proxies.

Registered about 37 hours before the submission deadline. The last moment for the conditions of the decision rule is not moved, so there is less time for integration, rehearsal and the checks on the team's computer than for any earlier release.

Inference bytes: the candidate's rounded probabilities on a synthetic input have the same SHA-256 (a91b133b...ba9ebf6b) on macOS arm64 (author: Python 3.12.13 / NumPy 2.5.4 and 3.10.20 / 1.26.4) and here on Linux x86-64 (Python 3.13.18 / numpy 2.5.3 and 3.10.20 / 1.26.4). Windows is first tested by the cross-platform step of the delivery chain. NumPy matrix products are not guaranteed bit-identical across BLAS builds; the 4-decimal and 6-decimal rounding makes a different output unlikely, not impossible.
The network runs eight members instead of three: the generation of the file takes several minutes longer.
The organisers state that differences below about 0.04 are noise on one match.
The reserve configuration without the kick-off rule (possession-release-graded-windows.json) stays the v2.11g ladder and uses no second model.
